title: Exercise promotes lipophagy and mitigates cognitive impairment in Alzheimer’s disease through downregulating microglial TMEM9
title_zh: 运动通过下调小胶质细胞TMEM9促进脂溶性自噬并缓解阿尔茨海默病认知障碍
abstract: Abstract Background Autophagy-lysosomal dysfunction contributes to lipid droplet (LD) accumulation, which drives pathological progression in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Exercise is reported to restore autophagy-lysosomal function and attenuate cognitive impairment in AD, but its regulation of LD deposition remains unknown. Methods 5×FAD transgenic mice underwent a three-month exercise intervention. Cognitive and emotional behaviors were assessed using the Morris water maze, novel object recognition, and open field test. LD deposition was evaluated by oil red O and BODIPY staining. Proteomic sequencing was performed to identify proteins affected by exercise. Pathological changes were examined by immunofluorescence, western blotting, and transmission electron microscopy. Intracerebroventricular injection of AAV was used to overexpress or knock down microglial TMEM9 to investigate the mechanisms by which physical exercise affects behavior and pathology in AD. In vitro, BV2 cells were cultured and incubated with oligomeric amyloid-β (oAβ), with or without oleic acid to induce LD formation. Chloroquine and rapamycin, which regulate autophagy-lysosomal function, were used to examine the effects of LDs on mitochondrial integrity under glucose deprivation conditions. Lentiviral or plasmid transfection was used to explore the key role of TMEM9 in regulating lipophagy, and the interaction between TMEM9 and ATP6AP1 was detected by co-immunoprecipitation. Clinically, plasma TMEM9 and ATP6AP1 levels in AD patients were measured by ELISA, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis was performed to evaluate diagnostic performance. Results Exercise mitigated cerebral LD deposition through enhanced lipophagy, preserving mitochondrial integrity and attenuating cognitive decline. Mechanistically, exercise suppressed microglial TMEM9 expression, restoring LD degradation. Tmem9 downregulation facilitated LKB1 lysosomal translocation, activating AMPK signaling. In vitro, oleic acid-induced LDs preserved mitochondrial membrane potential and increased ATP production in BV2 microglia under glucose deprivation and oAβ exposure. Tmem9 overexpression exacerbated lipophagy impairment and mitochondrial dysfunction, whereas Tmem9 knockdown enhanced lipophagy and cytoprotection. Aβ clearance was negatively regulated by TMEM9. Clinically, AD patients exhibited characteristic Aβ deposition and glucose hypometabolism, with plasma TMEM9 levels strongly correlating with p-tau217 progression. Plasma TMEM9 and the TMEM9/ATP6AP1 ratio emerged as potential AD diagnostic biomarkers (AUC=0.791 and 0.853, respectively). Conclusion These findings establish exercise-induced TMEM9 inhibition as a novel therapeutic strategy targeting lipidostasis to combat AD progression.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：自噬-溶酶体功能障碍导致脂滴（LD）堆积，推动阿尔茨海默病（AD）病理进展。已报道运动可恢复自噬-溶酶体功能并减轻AD认知障碍，但其对LD沉积的调控尚不清楚。方法：5×FAD转基因小鼠接受三个月运动干预。通过Morris水迷宫、新奇物体识别和开放场测试评估认知与情绪行为。使用油红O和BODIPY染色评估LD沉积。进行蛋白质组测序以识别受运动影响的蛋白。通过免疫荧光、蛋白印迹和透射电子显微镜检查病理变化。通过脑室内注射AAV过表达或敲低小胶质细胞TMEM9，探究运动影响AD行为与病理的机制。体外实验中，培养BV2细胞并用寡聚淀粉样β（oAβ）处理，加入或不加油酸诱导LD形成。使用氯喹和雷帕霉素调节自噬-溶酶体功能，检验LD在葡萄糖缺乏条件下对线粒体完整性的影响。利用慢病毒或质粒转染探究TMEM9在调节脂溶性自噬中的关键作用，并通过共免疫沉淀检测TMEM9与ATP6AP1的相互作用。临床上，通过ELISA测定AD患者血浆TMEM9和ATP6AP1水平，并进行受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估诊断性能。结果：运动通过增强脂溶性自噬减轻脑内LD沉积，保持线粒体完整性并缓解认知衰退。机制上，运动抑制小胶质细胞TMEM9表达，恢复LD降解。Tmem9下调促进LKB1溶酶体转位，激活AMPK信号通路。体外实验中，油酸诱导的LD在葡萄糖缺乏和oAβ暴露下保持BV2小胶质细胞线粒体膜电位并提高ATP产生。Tmem9过表达加重脂溶性自噬受损和线粒体功能障碍，而Tmem9敲低增强脂溶性自噬和细胞保护。Aβ清除受TMEM9负向调控。临床上，AD患者表现出典型的Aβ沉积和葡萄糖低代谢，血浆TMEM9水平与p-tau217进展高度相关。血浆TMEM9及TMEM9/ATP6AP1比例显示出潜在的AD诊断生物标志物（AUC=0.791和0.853）。结论：这些发现确立了运动诱导TMEM9抑制作为一种新型靶向脂质稳态的治疗策略，以对抗AD进展。
